verdict.rationale: Mastra is code-first: agents, workflows, suspend/resume, time travel, memory, streaming and observability are all defined and driven through the TypeScript API, and a Mastra server can be deployed. Studio, the UI, covers testing agents, running workflows and inspecting traces, and those core actions appear to have programmatic equivalents. However, nothing documents that every Studio action is exposed through the API, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity documentation, a documented HTTP/server API reference (e.g. OpenAPI) covering Studio functions such as trace inspection, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
